walkthrough:
Calculate the base angle $\angle BAC$ of the isosceles triangle $ACB$ (where $AB = BC = 8$ cm and base $AC = 12$ cm):
$$\cos(\angle BAC) = \frac{12 / 2}{8} = \frac{6}{8} = \frac{3}{4} = 0.75$$
$$\angle BAC = \cos^{-1}(0.75) \approx 0.722734 \text{ radians}$$

Apply the exterior angle theorem to triangle $ABC$ (where $\angle BCA = \angle BAC$):
$$\angle CBY = \angle BAC + \angle BCA = 2\angle BAC$$

Evaluate the angle $\angle CBY$ (to 4 significant figures):
$$\angle CBY = 2 \times 0.722734 = 1.44547 \approx 1.445 \text{ radians}$$

Calculate the length of arc $YC$ with radius $r = 8$ cm and angle $\theta = 1.445$ rad:
$$\text{Arc } YC = 8 \times 1.44547 \approx 11.5638 \text{ cm}$$

Calculate the length of arc $XC$ with radius $r = 12$ cm and angle $\angle XAC \approx 0.7227$ rad:
$$\text{Arc } XC = 12 \times 0.722734 \approx 8.6728 \text{ cm}$$

Determine the straight length $XY$ along the line:
$$AX = 12 \text{ cm}, \quad AY = AB + BY = 8 + 8 = 16 \text{ cm}$$
$$XY = AY - AX = 16 - 12 = 4 \text{ cm}$$

Sum the boundary lengths to find the perimeter (to 3 significant figures):
$$\text{Perimeter} = \text{Arc } YC + \text{Arc } XC + XY = 11.5638 + 8.6728 + 4 = 24.2366 \approx 24.2 \text{ cm}$$
